observations.title: Strong 2025 Recovery
observations.content: Atrium REIT delivered a strong recovery in FY2025 with 22.4% DPU growth to 9.30 sen, driven by 100% portfolio occupancy and ASA5 tenancy commencement.
observations.summary: 22.4% DPU growth, 100% occupancy, strong recovery trajectory

observations.title: Interest Rate Exposure
observations.content: Atrium REIT has ~93% floating-rate debt with no hedging instruments, making it highly sensitive to BNM OPR changes. Each +25bps increases finance costs by ~RM 0.87M annually.
observations.summary: ~93% floating-rate, no hedging, high rate sensitivity

observations.title: Lumileds Counterparty Risk
observations.content: Lumileds Malaysia contributes ~21% of revenue. Parent company Lumileds Holding B/V is rated SD (Selective Default) by S&P. However, Malaysia operations remain stable with 5,000+ employees and a 15-year lease through 2034.
observations.summary: ~21% revenue concentration, parent in selective default
